propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed to compute detection_proxy and blocking_fp_proxy from sidecar re-review history alone, without outcome-corpus git-walks or LLM calls, to automatically monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion.

The recorder reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows (ticket_id, review_ts, round_uuid, criterion_id, verdict, decision) to an append-only prune-immune ledger criterion_firings.jsonl, auto-including every criterion id seen.

The --report mode computes per-criterion detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction dropped/de-escalated by re-review and never remediated) over a trailing window of reviewed tickets.
The recorder is idempotent with dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id) and supports both --backfill (seed from entire existing corpus) and --record (incremental append) modes.
Per-criterion firings must be recorded deterministically with no LLM calls or new eval spend, matching the R7 gate_eval_instrumentation.py precedent.
